title: Managing Director – Implementation Center of Excellence (iCoE)_PMO
description:
**Role Purpose**


The MD for the Implementation Center of Excellence (iCoE) is accountable for establishing, scaling, and governing State Street’s high ‑ capability PMO function for client implementation across various workstreams in STT Alpha. The MD ensures that the iCoE becomes a **strategic capability** , reducing vendor dependency, improving cost efficiency, strengthening internal expertise, and enabling predictable client delivery at scale.  



**Key Responsibilities**


**iCoE Strategy, Design \& Build** ‑ **Out**


* Lead the end ‑ to ‑ end design and multi ‑ year implementation of the iCoE operating model, including functional scope, hiring strategy, location footprint, and resource mix.
  

Transition execution ‑ heavy work from high ‑ cost vendors into the iCoE through structured knowledge transfer, scaling internal capability, and reducing dependence on vendors
* A ligning contractor ‑ to ‑ FTE transitions and phasing resource migration strategically.
  

Drive FTE vs Contractor ratio strategy, establishing a sustainable talent supply model for PMO, and other iCoEs as required
**PMO** **CoE**

* The MD will oversee and build leadership capability across PMO functions – STT End to end implementation planning , Risk management, Reporting , Tools \& Automation / Ai initiatives
* Strengthen the focus on executing the PMO iCoE strategy, including contractor reduction, capability build\-out, location strategy and cost optimization
* A ccountable for the global strategy, delivery excellence, operating model, and financial performance of enterprise PMO services supporting large ‑ scale client implementations and platform transformations.
* Champion **AI** ‑ **enabled** **Program governance** **, intelligent** **data driven** **analytics, and** **risk** **management** capabilities
* Establish Standard governance, cadence, reporting standards, milestone planning, and dependencies management.
* Drive collaboration and partnerships with other CoEs and Alpha implementation teams to deliver client implementation programs successfully
* Stand up a unified India ‑ based PMO function with SMEs, leads, and analyst teams.
* Establish integrated support model with Conversion , Business Integration / Target Operating Model (TOM) Alignment , Environment Management, Alpha Data Services, Governance \& Vendor Relations .
* Ensure consistent delivery across **front, middle, and back** ‑ **office** **End to end** **implementations** , complex data flows, and integrations.
* Enable OBM (Outcome ‑ Based Model) transition by linking partner payments to outcomes and making sure that sub\-outcomes are delivered in a timely manner with expected quality
**People Leadership \& Capability Development**


* Build and lead a **leadership team** (VP/AVP layers) across PMO teams .
* Establish senior leadership layers within iCoE
* Manage onboarding of new hires , training, knowledge transfer and creation of standard PMO playbooks, frameworks and best practices.
* Drive capability building across CoEs , ensuring consistent training and best ‑ practice adoption.
* Foster a culture of **accountability, innovation, continuous improvement, and operational excellence** .
* Accountable for building a sustainable operating model, workforce planning, succession planning and long\-term hub growth.
* Establish **career paths, competency frameworks, and succession plans** for testing professionals.
* Lead capability build ‑ out in **India and other strategic hubs** , including CoE scale ‑ up and leadership bench strength.
* **Engage globally** and drive PMO strategy
**Governance, Reporting \& Stakeholder Engagement**


* Create and operate iCoE governance structures across program reporting (client implementations) , risk management, productivity metrics, and leadership oversight.
* Represent iCoE progress to senior leadership and participate in recurring strategic governance meetings.
* Provide **clear executive** ‑ **level reporting** on quality, risks, dependencies, and decision points.
* Ensure alignment with the broader GCI and Alpha three ‑ year strategy, including OBM rollout and partner consolidation.
**Operational Efficiency, Productivity \& Financial Management**


* Achieve targeted cost reductions by shifting work from high ‑ cost locations to the India hub.
  

Improve FTE ‑ to ‑ contractor and HCL ‑ to ‑ Hub ratios, driving labor arbitrage benefits and operational scalability.
* Responsible for process simplification, automation, digitalization and AI adoption to improve productivity and scalability.
* Drive automation, standardization, tool adoption, reporting quality, and process enhancement.
  

Track financials, onboarding flows, hiring dependencies, and realization of O utcome based milestone payments
* A ccountability for tracking and delivering business benefits/ outcomes, including contractor reduction, productivity improvements and cost savings.
* Engage with vendor partners to manage consultants and deliver quality results
* Support sales and pre ‑ sales activities through estimation models, proposals, and client solution shaping
**Required Skills \& Experience**


**Experience**


* 15 \+ years in large ‑ scale implementation, transformation, PMO leadership in client implementation programs (global model) , or delivery operations in financial services.
* Proven success managing global delivery hubs or Centers of Excellence at scale.
* Demonstrated experience transitioning vendor work in ‑ house and managing hybrid workforce models.
* Proven track record leading **global, complex, client** ‑ **facing transformation programmes** .
* Deep understanding of **financial services platforms** , data ‑ heavy architectures, and regulated environments.
* Demonstrated ownership of **P\&L, operating models, and large global team**
**Leadership \& Execution**


* Exceptional ability to build and lead multi ‑ disciplinary teams across Testing, PMO, Conversion, Product, Data, and Ops.
* Strong stakeholder influence across MD/SVP levels in Operations, Technology, and Client organizations.
**Technical \& Functional Acumen**


* Solid understanding of Front office, middle office and Back office components, implementation workflows, PMO tools and data migration models.
**Governance \& Change Management**


* Deep knowledge of PMO governance, risk management, performance metrics, and delivery controls.

**What we do.** State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data \& analytics, investment research \& trading and investment management to institutional clients.

title: Senior Specialist - Program & Project Management
description:
**Role description**  

This role is for an experienced professional to lead and manage complex programs and projects, ensuring successful delivery through robust project governance and Agile methodologies. The Senior Specialist will drive value\-driven outcomes, optimize project performance, and foster a culture of continuous improvement.





Job Description:



1\. Lead the planning, execution, and successful delivery of complex programs and projects, adhering to established timelines and budgets.



2\. Implement and maintain strong project governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with organizational standards and best practices.



3\. Apply Agile (Value\-Driven Delivery) principles and practices to optimize project workflows and maximize business value.



4\. Serve as a Scrum Master, facilitating Agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.



5\. Develop comprehensive project plans, including scope definition, resource allocation, risk management, and communication strategies.



6\. Define, track, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor project progress and identify areas for improvement.



7\. Proactively identify and mitigate project risks and issues, developing contingency plans to ensure project continuity.



8\. Foster effective communication and collaboration among cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.



9\. Coach and mentor team members on Agile methodologies and project management best practices.



10\. Explore and leverage AI\-enabled tools and technologies to enhance project delivery efficiency and performance.





Skills and Qualifications:


* 8\-12 years of progressive experience in program and project management roles.


* Proven expertise in Agile (Value\-Driven Delivery) methodologies and practices.


* Strong background in establishing and maintaining robust Project Governance.


* Demonstrated proficiency in comprehensive Project Planning.


* Certified Scrum Master or equivalent Agile certification is highly desirable.


* Experience in defining and tracking project KPIs.


* Ability to facilitate Agile ceremonies effectively.


* Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools for project management is a plus.


* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.


* Strong analytical and problem\-solving

title: Technology Program Manager
description:
* Full\-time

**Company Description**
-----------------------


AbhiBus is a leading online bus\-ticketing platform that aggregates ticket inventory from over 4,000 bus operators \- including major State Road Transport Corporations (SRTCs), covering more than 3\.5 lakh (350,000\+) routes across India. The AbhiBus website and apps allow users to check amenities provided by bus operators, compare booking fares, check bus timings in the searched route, live tracking of the bus before arrival, cancellation protection options and other facilities. It is the official ticketing partner for several state road transport corporation bus tickets and IRCTC bus bookings.


AbhiBus is owned and operated by ixigo (Le Travenues Technology Limited), India’s leading OTA for the Next Billion Users. With over 54 crore Annual Active Users in FY25, ixigo offers AI\-powered train, flight, bus, and hotel bookings through its platforms \- ixigo, ConfirmTkt, and AbhiBus.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**The Role**


We are looking for a Technology Program Manager who can drive complex, cross\-functional technology initiatives from problem definition to execution and delivery.  

  

This is not a traditional Scrum Master / Agile Project Manager role.  

  

You will work in an environment where requirements evolve, priorities change, teams may not be co\-located, and there isn't always a well\-defined process or single owner for every dependency.  

  

Your job will be to bring clarity, structure and momentum to these situations.  

  

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Operations and external technology partners to ensure that complex initiatives move forward and eventually reach production.

**What You Will Do**

* Drive end\-to\-end technology programs — translate high\-level objectives into clear plans, milestones, dependencies and execution paths.
* Navigate complex technical dependencies across multiple engineering teams, services, platforms and third\-party systems.
* Work closely with engineering leads to understand architecture, APIs, data flows, system dependencies and technical constraints well enough to identify execution risks early.
* Identify the critical path for programs and continuously remove blockers that could impact delivery.
* Coordinate execution across distributed and non\-co\-located teams, ensuring alignment without relying purely on formal processes.
* Bring structure to ambiguous problems — figure out what needs to happen, who needs to be involved and how we get from where we are today to the desired outcome.
* Identify risks, dependencies and decisions proactively rather than waiting for issues to surface.
* Facilitate discussions between teams when there are conflicting priorities, unclear ownership or competing technical approaches.
* Partner with Product Managers and Engineering Managers to convert product/business objectives into executable technology plans.
* Maintain program visibility for leadership — what is on track, what is blocked, why it is blocked and what decisions are required.
* Manage execution across multiple parallel workstreams without becoming a task tracker.
* Work with external vendors/partners where technology integration or operational dependencies are involved.
* Establish lightweight processes where needed — but avoid adding process for the sake of process.
**Qualifications**
------------------

* 3–5 years of experience in Technical Program Management, Product Operations, Engineering Program Management, Technology Consulting or a similar role.
* Strong understanding of software development and technology systems. You don't need to be a coder, but you should be comfortable discussing APIs, databases, services, integrations, data flows, releases and system dependencies with engineers.
* Demonstrated experience driving cross\-functional technology initiatives involving multiple teams.
* Strong ability to understand technical dependencies and identify risks before they become delivery problems.
* Comfortable working with ambiguity, changing priorities and incomplete information.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, particularly across teams with different priorities.
* Ability to operate effectively with distributed / geographically dispersed engineering teams.
* Strong ownership mindset — you see a problem through to resolution rather than simply escalating it.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.


Ability to operate in a high\-paced startup environment where processes are evolving continuously.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience working in a consumer internet, marketplace, OTA, fintech, mobility or other high\-scale technology environment.
* Experience working with microservices, APIs, cloud infrastructure or data platforms.
* Engineering / Computer Science background.
* Experience working with external technology vendors or partners.
* Experience managing programs involving multiple engineering teams and complex integrations.
* Experience in an environment where Product and Engineering operate with high autonomy and lightweight processes.

**What Success Looks Like**


After 6 months, you should be the person teams rely on to answer:

* What exactly are we trying to deliver?
* Which teams and systems are involved?
* What are the critical dependencies?
* What is blocking us?
* Who needs to make a decision?
* What can derail the program?
* What needs to happen next?

**You don't need to create more meetings or more status reports.**  

  

**You need to make complex things happen.**

**Additional Information**
--------------------------


Candidates are responsible for safeguarding sensitive company data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, and for reporting any suspected security incidents in line with the organization's ISMS (Information Security Management System) policies and procedures.

title: Project Erection & Site Management
description:
**Job Requirements**  

Site Engineer must ensure safe, correct, and timely **installation of DG sets, panels, fuel system, exhaust system, earthing, and cabling** as per approved drawings, standards, and safety norms. **Data Centre experience is preferred**.

  

* Pre\-Site Preparation \& Resource Readiness – Verify approved drawings, layouts, P\&IDs, piping/cable schedules, and ensure site readiness, manpower safety induction, tools, lifting equipment, testing kits, and PPE availability before mobilization.
* Material Handling \& Equipment Installation – Inspect and verify receipt/storage of DG sets, heat exchangers, pumps, cooling towers, piping, valves, and accessories; carry out proper installation, alignment, levelling, grouting, and mounting of DG sets and associated equipment as per approved drawings.
* Mechanical System Installation – Execute installation of exhaust, fuel, water cooling, and piping systems including silencers, insulation, flexible joints, valves, strainers, NRVs, vents, drains, supports, expansion loops, and hydro/pressure testing of pipelines.
* Cooling Water \& Cooling Tower Integration – Install and commission heat exchangers, cooling water/raw water pumps, cooling tower structures, piping connections, gauges, VFD/starter panels, and ensure proper alignment, rotation checks, water quality, and chemical dosing systems.
* Electrical, Cabling \& Earthing Works – Install AMF/synchronizing panels, lay and terminate LT/HT cables, verify control wiring/interlocks for DG–HE–Pump–CT systems, conduct IR tests, and ensure proper earthing/bonding with resistance monitoring and logs.
* Pre\-Commissioning \& Testing Activities – Perform leak tests, hydrotests, insulation tests, alignment and rotation checks, verify oil/coolant/fuel/battery conditions, confirm relay settings, alarms, interlocks, and sensor feedback systems before commissioning.
* Safety, Compliance \& Project Documentation – Ensure adherence to PPE, PTW, rigging, welding, fire safety, MSDS, and site safety practices while maintaining daily logs, installation/test reports, inspection clearances, as\-built drawings, and final handover**.**

  

**Work Experience**  

Site Execution, Erection Management, Testing \& Commissioning, Contractor Management, Project Planning

title: Asst Project Manager_DC
description:
**What will you do:**



As a Senior Service Engineer, you will deliver advanced service, commissioning, and troubleshooting expertise for chiller systems in mission\-critical data center environments. You will:


* Perform service, preventive maintenance, and corrective repairs on Air\-Cooled and Water\-Cooled Chillers, including screw, scroll, and centrifugal systems.
* Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and control\-related issues in chiller and HVAC systems.
* Conduct chiller start\-up, commissioning, performance testing, and system optimization.
* Manage site execution for data center cooling projects, including planning, installation oversight, and coordination with contractors and OEM teams.
* Support upgrades, retrofits, and energy\-efficiency improvements in existing cooling infrastructure.

* Ensure compliance with safety standards, regulatory requirements, and customer\-specific operational protocols.
* Provide technical mentorship to junior engineers and technicians.
* Interface regularly with customers to provide updates, clarify technical issues, and ensure timely project and service completion.
* Conduct root\-cause analysis and implement corrective/preventive actions.
* Collaborate with internal teams including sales, engineering, and project management to ensure seamless service delivery.

**What you will bring: (Skills \& Competencies)**


* Strong expertise in Air‑Cooled and Water‑Cooled Chillers, ideally in data center environments.
* Deep understanding of refrigeration cycles, HVAC controls, BMS/EMS integration, and redundancy concepts.
* Proficiency in diagnosing mechanical, electrical, and controls issues using diagnostic tools and software.
* Ability to interpret wiring diagrams, technical drawings, P\&IDs, and OEM manuals.
* Strong communication skills to operate effectively in mission‑critical customer environments.
* Sound knowledge of safety standards and best practices.
* Strong problem\-solving capability and ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Experience supporting mission\-critical data centers or large industrial cooling systems.
* OEM\-specific training or certifications (Trane, Carrier, Daikin) preferred.
* Knowledge of energy\-efficiency programs, retrofits, and performance optimization.

Because that’s how we change the lives of patients for the better. And that’s how we create better together. Why work at Enovis? See for yourself.


As a key member of the team, you will play an integral part in helping Enovis drive the medical technology industry forward by transforming patient care and improving patient outcomes.

**Job Title:**  

**Project Manager Market Access**


We are seeking a motivated and skilled **Project Manager Market Access** to join the Global RECON Regulatory Affairs Department. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in engineering and proven experience in managing cross\-functional projects. This role requires a proactive individual with excellent organizational and communication skills, capable of driving results in a dynamic and regulated environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and coordinate project activities across departments to ensure timely and successful execution.
* Manage project timelines, resources, and deliverables in alignment with company goals with relation to the Market Access activities.
* Communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
* Monitor project risks and implement mitigation strategies.
* Prepare and present project reports.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering (preferably Management or Biomedical Engineering).
* Minimum of 3 years of experience in project management, ideally in the **medical devices industry**.
* Familiarity with **MDR (Medical Device Regulation)** or similar regulatory frameworks is highly desirable.
* Certification in Project Management is a plus.
* Proficiency in project management software (e.g., MS Project).
* Excellent command of English (spoken and written).

**Key Competencies**

* Problem\-solving and decision\-making
* Change management
* Time management and prioritization
* Effective communication and negotiation
* Resilience and reliability

**ABOUT ENOVIS**  

Enovis Corporation (NYSE: ENOV) is an innovation\-driven medical technology growth company dedicated to developing clinically differentiated solutions that generate measurably better patient outcomes and transform workflows. Powered by a culture of continuous improvement, global talent and innovation, the Company’s extensive range of products, services and integrated technologies fuels active lifestyles in orthopedics and beyond. Visit www.enovis.com to learn more.

**“Creating better together”. It’s the Enovis purpose, and it’s what drives us and empowers us every day on a global scale.** We know that the power to create better – for our customers, our team members, and our shareholders – begins with having the best team, pursuing common goals, operating at the highest levels, and delivering extraordinary outcomes.

Job Title: Project Manager – Construction

**Company:** Kapil Power \& Infra (P) Ltd.  
**Experience:** 10\+ Years  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Salary:** Negotiable based on experience and interview performance  
**Location:** Project/Site Locations

Job Summary

Kapil Power \& Infra (P) Ltd. is seeking an experienced **Project Manager – Construction** to oversee construction projects, site execution, project coordination, quality, timelines, resources and team management.

The ideal candidate should have **10\+ years of relevant construction/project management experience** and be capable of independently managing project/site operations.

Responsibilities

* Manage end\-to\-end construction activities at assigned project sites.
* Plan and monitor project execution and ensure timely completion.
* Supervise site engineers, supervisors, contractors and subcontractors.
* Coordinate with clients, consultants, vendors and internal departments.
* Monitor manpower, materials, equipment and other project resources.
* Ensure construction work follows approved drawings, specifications and quality standards.
* Conduct site inspections and quality checks.
* Track project progress and identify potential delays or execution issues.
* Resolve site\-level technical and operational challenges.
* Prepare and maintain project reports, records and documentation.
* Ensure compliance with safety requirements and company policies.
* Provide regular project updates to management.
* Ensure proper site management, supervision and team coordination.
* Work according to project requirements, including extended working hours or Sundays when necessary.

Requirements

* Minimum **10\+ years of experience** in construction/project management.
* Strong experience in site execution and construction management.
* Good knowledge of construction processes and project coordination.
* Strong leadership and team\-management skills.
* Excellent communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to manage multiple project activities and priorities.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities.
* Candidates with experience in **infrastructure, industrial, solar or similar construction projects** are preferred.

Compensation

**Salary will be discussed and finalized based on the candidate's experience, skills and interview performance.**

How to Apply

Interested candidates can send their **updated resume** to: **udayasriv@kapilpower.com**

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹80,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
